reviews.text:
It's been about 20 years since I last visited them! ♡
When WITH first opened, they had a dog cafe and salon in front of Shinjuku Gyoen, and my beloved golden retriever was a regular customer. After she passed away, I focused on adopting only senior rescue dogs over 13 years old, so our connection drifted apart. (WITH has a policy that first grooming is only for dogs under 10 years old.)
This time, after more than a decade, I adopted a young rescue dog, and when I wanted to get her groomed, WITH was the first place that came to mind. I contacted them and made a reservation.
The groomer who was a newcomer back then has become a wonderful manager, and I'm filled with nostalgia and joy at this renewed connection. ♡
The manager also remembered me, and she was so friendly and welcoming, it was as if I hadn't noticed the more than ten-year gap at all. She gave my shaggy rescue Pomeranian a beautiful cut, and I can't thank her any more.

When I'm busy, I can request pick-up and drop-off as an option, and they'll even look after my dog ​​for up to two hours after grooming, which is incredibly helpful when I need to squeeze it in between work.
I understand the current location has been around for about 15 years, but this was my first visit and I was very impressed by its cleanliness, lack of unpleasant odors, and overall positive impression.
The grooming room is glass-walled, so you can see the meticulous grooming process.
All in all, I'm so happy to be able to visit this familiar salon again; it's added another monthly treat! ♡
I look forward to continuing our relationship for many years to come.
The image is from WITH's Instagram. It's the first time I've seen a picture of the shampooing process, so it's refreshing and wonderful! ♡
I imagine posting on Instagram is a lot of work, but I really enjoy it, so please keep it up! ♡
Thank you to the manager and everyone else! ♡♡♡

Addendum 2026.8.26
This was my second grooming session, three weeks later.
Because I left a review on Google Maps last time, they offered me a special service: a pink foam pack! ♡ I was wondering how they would do the pack, and then they posted a picture of it on Instagram afterwards, which reassured me and made me happy to see it! ♡
After just two sessions, my fur is so fluffy! ♡
Thank you! ♡

Thank you for your continued support!

My pet always comes back looking so fluffy!

I really appreciate the pick-up and drop-off service and the variety of payment options.

I requested pick-up, drop-off, and grooming services, and the process was smooth! My dog ​​came back with a cute pink ribbon, and I'm very happy with the result!

They even took a photo of my desired cut, which made me feel confident leaving my dog ​​in their care.

They also gave my dog ​​a carbonated bath and a bubble pack, resulting in a fluffy and silky finish! The pick-up and drop-off service is more convenient and cheaper than taking a taxi round trip, which is a great help!

I had my dog ​​shampooed and given a carbonated spring bath for the second time. I can really see the difference; the shedding has decreased, and his fur is fluffier and cleaner. The staff were very helpful, and I'll definitely use their services again.

This was my first time getting my dog ​​shampooed at a salon. They even offered a free carbonated spring bath for first-time customers, and I'm so happy with how shiny and smooth my dog's fur is now!

They removed about a soccer ball's worth of loose hair, so it looks like my dog ​​won't be shedding anymore! 😂
The manager and groomer were both very nice, which put me at ease!

Thank you so much! 😭

We've been using this salon's services since our dog was a puppy. Thanks to the shampoos they offer, everyone we meet compliments her on her beautiful coat.

Our dog is a Shiba Inu, and when she was little, the staff discovered illnesses we hadn't noticed, such as interdigital dermatitis. Their meticulous care has been a real lifesaver. Since we live nearby, we often see the staff during walks, and they're all very kind and friendly.

We look forward to continuing our relationship with you.

The staff were so kind, and I felt completely at ease leaving my child in their care.
My child is a little timid, but I was so impressed that they didn't force anything and adjusted to the pace. I'm very happy with the fluffy finish!
I was also thrilled to see photos of the carbonated spring bath and the herbal pack they tried for the first time on Instagram! ✨️
I heard they offer pick-up and drop-off, so I'd like to use that service next time when I'm busy!

I'm still furious!!!

I'd been consistently taking my two dogs there for nearly five years, but one day I was told there would be a cancellation fee from now on.

Honestly, I'd never canceled a single appointment in those five years, but that day, due to a combination of health issues and other things, I asked if I could reschedule. However, I was charged a cancellation fee for both dogs, and I had to take a taxi to force them there. In the end, only one dog was groomed, but it was a terrible cut (I didn't complain because they had told me beforehand that they might not be able to cut properly due to time constraints).

But still, a cancellation fee, taxi fare, and a terrible cut—it's not a pleasant feeling, is it?
To a long-time customer like me...
Is this shop even competent? That's what I thought.
It used to be good, though.

Even though I explained the reason for the cancellation beforehand, they stubbornly insisted on charging me an exorbitant cancellation fee. When I asked why, they said, "There have been a lot of cancellations recently."

Honestly, I've been going there for a long time and have a good track record, so I thought, "I don't care about that reason."

I haven't been back since that day, and when I talk to people I meet on walks and the topic of grooming comes up, I tell them, "You should stop going there."
I really like the scent after using the grooming shampoo.

I was recommended by a neighbor and asked for their services.
The carbonated spring bath was free on the first visit, and I was surprised at how fluffier my hair was afterwards.
They posted photos of the finished product and the carbonated spring bath on the shop's Instagram, and I couldn't help but save them.
It was reassuring to see that I was relaxing in the bath.
They also offer a shuttle service, so I'll try using it when they're busy!
